concept_reference.name: ManiLadder WrapRope-v1
concept_reference.license: MIT (concept reference only; no task code/assets copied)

infrastructure.reused: launcher, collector, client transport, container layout

physical_model.rope: 60 passive ball joints, 4 mm capsule radius, total mass 0.16 kg
physical_model.stiffness: 80-segment-equivalent coefficient scaled by segments/80 to preserve distributed bending stiffness
physical_model.core: vertical radius 0.08 m, half-height 0.12 m at z=0.17 m
physical_model.groove: two contact capsule rails, each 120 pieces, radius 0.006 m, vertical offsets +/-0.011 m
physical_model.grasp: one initial point-connect equality between free endpoint and force-limited Cartesian hand
physical_model.anchor: first pivot fixed to world at groove start
physical_model.hand: 0.08 kg, three slide joints, 1200 N/m position gains, 25 Ns/m servo damping, 12 N cap per axis
physical_model.gravity: MuJoCo default -9.81 m/s^2; hand gravity compensated
physical_model.joint_damping: 0.0004 * segments / 80 N m s/rad; 0.0003 for 60 segments; passive viscous damping

differences_from_concept: arc-length groove occupancy required for success
